reason: A CLI and chat-command importer that reads Codex App Server conversation history, converts it into DeepSeek Harness sessions, and attaches eligible historical workspaces.

summaries.zh: 通过 Codex App Server 读取对话历史，将其转换为 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并为符合条件的历史工作目录创建或复用工作区关联。
summaries.en: Imports conversation history through the Codex App Server, converts it into DeepSeek Harness sessions, and creates or reuses workspace attachments for eligible historical working directories.

capabilities: Reads Codex conversation history through the Codex App Server
Converts completed, interrupted, and failed turns into Harness session events
Writes imported sessions and workspace attachments through Harness public services
Starts and manages a local Codex App Server subprocess
